description:
FILED s521a (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-18) from the IO-Compress one-file runs after #3431/#3433/#3435 un-stuck the files: two Test::More / Test::Builder entry points the TAP layer (cl/pcl-test.lisp) does not implement now ABORT files.
  t/004gziphdr.t: ran 450 of 919 -- "Undefined subroutine &main::eq_set called" (Test::More's eq_set; the TAP layer lists it in %test-more-stash-install's export list but has no pl-eq_set).
  t/112utf8-zip.t: ran 20 of 29 (was 7 before #3435) -- `Can't locate object method "details" via package "Test::Builder"` (Test::Builder->details, the per-row results list).
FIX SHAPE: implement eq_set (perl: order-insensitive eq_array over sorted copies; Test::More's exact rules) and Test::Builder::details (the list of {ok, actual_ok, name, type, reason} hashes for the rows run so far) in the TAP layer -- a harness change: the companion --all --quick per batch.

=== NOTE (s521a, same session) ===
The eq_set half DUPLICATES #3432 (already filed, already cited by the 004gziphdr.t *PLAN* row): this task owns only Test::Builder->details (112utf8-zip.t).
subject: TAP layer gaps that now ABORT IO-Compress files: Test::More eq_set is undefined (004gziphdr.t ran 450 of 919) and Test::Builder->details is missing (112utf8-zip.t ran 20 of 29)
